correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the canonical metric on the column simplex in 1-perp: barycentric inward facet normals are L^+ e_v and their Gram is C=(L^+)^2. For the clique-windmill, orthogonal eigenspaces inside blade (eigenvalue s+1), block variation (1), and hub direction (N=sm+1) give exact entries C_00=sm/N^3, C_0v=-N^-3, diagonal D=(s+3)/(s+1)^2-q, same blade U=(s+2)/(s+1)^2-q, distinct blades -q, q=(1-N^-3)/(sm). Interior cosine is negative normalized Gram, giving cross q/D, hub (sm N^3 D)^-1/2, blade -U/D. The inequalities U>0,D>q>0 and q^2 sm N^3>D prove strict order. Ridge multiplicities partition binom(N,2), and mK_s plus one isolate reconstructs the blades; one-blade m=1 is regular with cosine 1/s. Fixed-s expansions follow q~1/(sm), D~(s+3)/(s+1)^2. Independently computed Laplacian Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse matrices for 2<=s,m<=4 and compared all Gram entries exactly/numerically; these finite examples check formulas but the spectral proof covers all integers.
